title: Behavior manifest row
description: One behavior rendered in one language. METADATA ONLY: this schema forbids prompt text, model outputs, and credentials, so that manifests can be tracked in git while the corpus stays in git-ignored data/. See THIRD_PARTY_DATASETS.md.

record_id.description: Stable ID for this behavior in this language and variant.

behavior_id.description: Shared by all seven language renderings of the same behavior.

arm.description: Both arms are mandatory; a harmful-only evaluation is trivially gamed by a pipeline that vetoes everything.

behavior_family.description: Topic/domain grouping used to match the benign arm to the harmful arm family-by-family.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the Unicode-normalised text. Lets collaborators verify an identical corpus build without exchanging the text.

normalization.description: NFKC/NFKD are excluded: compatibility folding rewrites the orthographic distinctions under study.

variant.description: Alternative rendering (e.g. retranslation). Variants are new records, never in-place edits.

translation_method.description: Non-pivot languages must not declare 'original'. Unreviewed MT is a named confound, not an assumption.

backtranslation_similarity.description: Similarity of a back-translation to the pivot rendering; measures translation drift.

orthography.description: Text-free fingerprint (counts and Unicode category profile). Distinguishes 'the model failed in Yoruba' from 'preprocessing stripped the diacritics'.

license_id.description: Upstream license. NOT MIT. Third-party terms are authoritative.
